item.title: What makes this an SCP?
item.content:encoded:
Basically, what Aarontastic said - this article isn't poorly written and the idea is sound, but this just doesn't seem like something the SCP Foundation would get involved in. I see no reason why the CDC couldn't handle this virus just as it does smallpox. Yes, it's disturbing - maybe even something that needs to be covered up to protect a government science department - but it's not something that belongs here.

I feel like some people get too focused on the articles here being disturbing and lose sight of what the SCP Foundation is supposed to be. It's not just an organization that contains things that are disturbing, or even things that are potentially world-ending; it's an organization that contains things that can't be explained by modern science. By the logic that would make this an SCP, the atomic bomb should be an SCP, too.

Downvoted for missing the point of the SCP Foundation.
